description: A null value is admitted when an alternative is null-typed.
descriptor: { descriptor_version: "1.0", root: { type: "object", children: { u: { type: "union", children_options: [ { type: "null" }, { type: "int" } ] } } } }

divergence.note: The baseline applies the null rule to the union node itself, before it ever consults the alternatives, so a union of {null} and {int} rejects null with a nullable issue even though one alternative is exactly null. The Dart implementation lets a null reach the alternatives, so the null-typed member admits it.
